findings.function: initialize paths (Initializable checks) and the PPM constant users
findings.source: OpenZeppelin Initializable: InitializableStorage at the ERC-7201 slot 0xf0c57e16840df040f15088dc2f81fe391c3923bec73e23a9662efc9c229c6a00 (_initialized, _initializing)
findings.issue: An instance of P1 that hides a storage slot: the namespaced slot 0xf0c57e16... is printed as a product with 3600, so the same slot appears both as stor[X * 3600] and as storF0C5_64 in one condition.
findings.rule: Never factor a constant used as a storage key (or any 256-bit hash-like constant) by a time unit; print the slot in hex and resolve it to the declared name.

notes: Source loops: multicall (MulticallUpgradeable 32, while idx < data.length) and LinkedList.traverse (while (cursor != 0 && iterations > 0) as while True with the test first; inlined in releaseStake and twice in unknownb15d2a2c). traverse's processItem is a delegatecall to the StakeClaims library (0x11bf8548...), shown with raw-memory args. Implicit: new bytes[](n) initialization (while idx - 1, P3) and one result copy (P7). Immutables (getDisputeManager, graph contracts) read as 0 (artifact, not separately reported). 7 events print their data as raw memory at the free pointer.
summary: Small, faithful text with both loops present; its worst line factors the Initializable ERC-7201 storage slot by 3600 (P1), and events/calls still use raw memory.
